channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: PGR pede que caso Lulinha deixe STF e vá pra 1ª instância, diz defesa
item.description: The Brazilian Attorney General's Office (PGR) requested that investigations involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, be transferred to the first instance, claiming there is no special jurisdiction. Three inquiries investigate suspicions of influence peddling and corruption linked to the INSS discount scheme. Lulinha's defense states that the PGR also argued about the absence of privileged jurisdiction to justify the transfer.

item.title: Caso Lulinha: o jogo de empurra sobre acesso de lobista ao governo e a preocupação com desgaste para a campanha de Lula
item.description: The Lulinha case involves lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, who allegedly posed as a representative of President Lula's son to gain access to the federal government. PT allies debate who should take responsibility for the incident, worrying about political damage to Lula's reelection. The Federal Police investigation aims to determine if Lulinha's name was used as a credential and who authorized the contact.

item.title: Lula se reúne com advogado de Lulinha e pede para ele se explicar
item.description: President Lula met with Marco Aurélio Carvalho, lawyer for Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, to discuss ongoing investigations involving his son. The meeting, held in Brasília, raises concerns about political influence and transparency in investigations involving relatives of public figures. It is seen as an indication of the administration's concern regarding legal proceedings affecting family members of political leaders.

item.title: Agenda dos candidatos: Lula vai ao RN e Flávio Bolsonaro cumpre compromissos em SP
item.description: Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) follow separate schedules: the president travels to Rio Grande do Norte for science and technology events and holds his first political rally in the Northeast; Flávio attends commitments in São Paulo with Mayor Ricardo Nunes and ends the day with a live stream.

item.title: PGR pede que caso de Lulinha deixe STF e seja julgado na 1ª instância
item.description: The Brazilian Attorney General's Office requested the Supreme Federal Court to transfer the investigation involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, to the lower court, arguing there is no privileged jurisdiction in the case. The investigation points to alleged corruption and influence peddling in the negotiation of a medical cannabis project with the federal government, involving lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger.

item.title: O estado em que Lula tem mais de 40 pontos de vantagem sobre Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: A survey by Real Time Big Data shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading with 65% of first-round voting intentions in Ceará, compared to 21% for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), securing a 44-point advantage. In the second round, Lula holds 66%, while Flávio rises to 27%, widening the gap to 39 points. Furthermore, 57% of Ceará voters completely reject Flávio Bolsonaro, making him the most rejected candidate in the state.

item.title: Amiga de Lulinha intermediava contrato de R$ 626 milhões com o governo Lula, indica minuta
item.description: A draft contract sent by lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, indicates a plan to sell cannabidiol-based medications to the Lula government for R$626 million. The document was addressed to Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, former chief of staff to President Lula.

item.title: Em nome de Lula, Durigan acena com ajuste gradual das contas públicas para reduzir juros
item.description: Finance Minister Dário Durigan stated that, in a potential new Lula term, the team will implement a 2% GDP fiscal adjustment, maintaining the fiscal framework and focusing on cutting mandatory spending and increasing revenue. The strategy aims to reduce high interest rates and ensure fiscal sustainability with an effort similar to the current administration.

item.title: Lula tem 66% contra 27% de Flávio no 2º turno no Ceará
item.description: A survey from Ceará shows Lula leading with 66% of voting intentions in a potential second round against Flávio Bolsonaro, who received 27%. Rejection of Flávio is the highest in the state, with 57% of voters saying they would not vote for him.

item.title: Lula é o preferido dos eleitores paraenses, indica pesquisa AtlasIntel
item.description: A AtlasIntel survey shows that President Lula (PT) is the most preferred candidate among Pará voters for the 2026 Brazilian presidency, leading in all first-round and runoff projections. Lula holds a significant lead over his main rivals, including Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), Romeu Zema (Novo), and others.

item.title: O desempenho de Lula e Flávio no maior colégio eleitoral do norte, segundo pesquisa
item.description: An AtlasIntel poll of 1,197 Pará voters shows Lula leading with 48.9% of voting intentions against 37.4% for Flávio Bolsonaro, within a ±3 percentage point margin of error. The survey also reflects strong performance by state candidates aligned with the Pará governor.

item.title: AtlasIntel: Lula vence em todos os cenários testados de 2º turno no PA
item.description: AtlasIntel poll shows Lula winning in all runoff scenarios in Pará, with 50.8% against Flávio Bolsonaro's 42.7%. In the first round, Lula leads with 48.9% of voting intentions, followed by Flávio with 37.4%. The survey was conducted between August 14 and 19, 2026, interviewing 1,197 Pará voters.

item.title: Nikolas tenta colar crise fictícia em vídeo de campanha e é desmentido
item.description: Nikolas Ferreira used misleading footage of food prices to criticize the government in his campaign video, a tactic discredited by the Noblat panel. The episode raises concerns about disinformation in electoral campaigns and highlights the weakness of opposition messaging.

item.title: Campanha de Lula pressiona ministro da Justiça para blindar Lulinha?
item.description: Lula's campaign (PT) plans to pressure the Minister of Justice, Wellington César Lima e Silva, to shield the president's son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, who is under investigation. The leak of information about the case is sparking speculation about political interference in the investigation.

item.title: Advogado admite ter falado sobre Lulinha com Lula
item.description: Lawyer Marco Aurélio de Carvalho, coordinator of the Prerrogativas group, admitted that the 'Lulinha' case was discussed tangentially with President Lula after a meeting at the Alvorada Palace. He clarified that no specific details about the defense of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva were addressed.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest testa a disputa Lula x Flávio no reduto da Lava-Jato
item.description: Quaest has registered an electoral survey with the TSE to measure voting intentions in Paraná for the Presidency and state races. The presidential race features Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and other candidates, while gubernatorial and Senate races are analyzed across multiple scenarios. Data collection runs from August 20–23, with results scheduled for release on August 24.

item.title: Lula pede que deputado deixe função de vice-líder do governo
item.description: President Lula requested the Chamber of Deputies to remove Mauro Benevides Filho (União Brasil-CE) as government vice-leader, as published in the Official Gazette. The move follows the congressman's switch from PDT to União Brasil in March 2026.

item.title: Lula vence Flávio Bolsonaro de goleada no Ceará, mostra pesquisa
item.description: A survey released in Ceará shows President Lula (PT) leading with 65% of voting intentions in the first round, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) at 21%. Lula's advantage remains around 40 percentage points in the second round, with 66% against Flávio's 27%.

item.title: Eleições 2026: dois a cada 100 candidatos são PCDs
item.description: The 2026 elections set a new milestone for the inclusion of candidates with disabilities (PCDs), with two PCD candidates per 100 in the electoral landscape, according to TSE data. This increase reflects greater visibility and political participation of PCDs, highlighting progress in the representation of this group.

item.title: Cid Gomes é o favorito dos cearenses para o Senado, mostra pesquisa
item.description: A survey by Real Time Big Data shows Cid Gomes (PSB) as the favorite among Ceará voters for the Senate in 2026 with 27% of voting intentions, followed by a tie between Capitão Wagner (União Brasil) and Luizianne Lins (Rede), both at 21%. The race for the second seat remains tight, with Alcides Fernandes (PL) at 14%.

item.title: Saiba quem são os candidatos ao governo e ao Senado no Ceará
item.description: In the 2026 elections in Ceará, there are eight candidates for state governor and eight for the Federal Senate. Among the key figures are Ciro Gomes (PSDB), former governor and federal minister, and Elmano de Freitas (PT), the current governor. The race also includes Danilo Soares (Democrata) and Delegado Huggo (Missão), along with Senate candidates such as Alcides Fernandes (PL) and Cid Gomes (PSB). Voters will choose the president of the Republic, governor, two senators, and federal and state deputies.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: Haddad states that Flávio Bolsonaro poses a risk to the country in economic, social, and international dimensions, rejecting the possibility of his government. The statement reinforces the former minister's critical stance toward a key figure of bolsonarismo for 2026.

item.title: Saiba quais pesquisas eleitorais podem sair nesta 5ª feira
item.description: Electoral polls registered with the TSE in eight Brazilian states are authorized for release starting Thursday, August 20, 2026. The data, formally submitted to Electoral Justice, depend on regulatory deadlines and contractor decisions. The Poder360 Research Aggregator collects surveys since 2000, with 2026 data available during the electoral period.

item.title: Saiba o que os candidatos ao Planalto farão nesta 5ª feira
item.description: Presidential candidates carry out campaign events and official duties across Brasília, São Paulo, and Maceió on Thursday (Aug 20, 2026). Lula announces AI supercomputer; Flávio Bolsonaro focuses on São Paulo; Caiado, Zema, Santos, and Cury hold varied agendas. Most activities are neutral with no mention of controversial topics.

item.title: Agenda de Lula: leia os compromissos do presidente nesta 5ª
item.description: President Lula has an agenda in Brasília and travels to Rio Grande do Norte to announce an artificial intelligence supercomputer at the Augusto Severo Scientific and Technological Park in Macaíba, before returning to the capital.

item.title: Canabidiol: amiga de Lulinha enviou a Marcola proposta de R$ 626 milhões
item.description: Businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger sent a contract draft to Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro, aka Marcola, then chief of staff to President Lula, proposing a non‑bidding sale of up to R$ 626 million in cannabidiol‑based medicines to the Health Ministry. The draft was discovered on the phones of Roberta and Antonio Carlos Camilo Antunes, known as 'Careca do INSS', and indicates the scheme was facilitated by Lula’s son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha). Although the deal never materialized, the Federal Police are investigating the parties for alleged influence‑peddling and corruption.

item.title: Poder360 abre acesso ao Políticos do Brasil, com dados desde 1998
item.description: Poder360 launched 'Políticos do Brasil', a database with all candidates' info since 1998, including asset evolution and detailed profiles. Free access during 2026 election period; Poder Drive subscribers get full archive.

item.title: Poder360 abre acesso ao Agregador de Pesquisas mais completo da mídia
item.description: Poder360 opened free access to its Poll Aggregator for the 2026 elections, compiling over 620 surveys. The tool allows filtering by round, scope, moving average, and polling firm, showing voting intention trends with Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) highlighted as frontrunners in presidential polls.

item.title: Mesmo com apoio de Alcolumbre, avanço de prioridades de Lula é incerto antes das eleições
item.description: Despite Lula's rapprochement with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, priority government PECs (ending the 6×1 work scale and public security) will likely only advance in the Senate's CCJ after elections. Committee chair Otto Alencar requires debate before voting, delaying consideration until senators return from campaign trails.

item.title: Políticos do PL mostram ônibus enfileirados em ato pró-Lula
item.description: PL politicians, including councilwoman Nina Braga and state deputy Paulo Mansur, denounced the PT's mobilization of over 100 chartered buses to bring supporters to Lula's reelection campaign launch in São Bernardo do Campo. They claim the event was artificially filled and funded by the party, without providing evidence.

item.title: Prazo para pedir voto em trânsito termina hoje: veja como solicitar
item.description: The deadline to request voting in transit for the 2026 elections is August 20. Voters outside their electoral domicile can request a temporary change of polling place via the TSE's online portal or in person at electoral courts. The modality allows voting for president, governor, senator, and deputies if staying in the same state, or only for president if in a different state.

item.title: Deputado distrital e federal são as vagas mais concorridas de 2026
item.description: The 2026 elections show high competition for district and federal deputy seats, averaging 17.8 candidates per seat in the Federal District and 15 per seat in the Chamber of Deputies. The presidency has 13 candidates, including Pablo Marçal, who is ineligible. The lowest competition is for governor (7.3 per seat) and senator (5.9 per seat).

item.title: E as eleições, hein?
item.description: A Metrópoles poll shows 81.1% of 1,167 readers have already decided their vote for the two Senate seats. Noblat's blog features articles on Lula and national politics.

item.title: De pai para filho: quem são os ‘nepobabies’ candidatos em 2026
item.description: The article maps the prevalence of political dynasties in the 2026 elections, highlighting children of legislators and former presidents running for federal and state offices. Families such as Bolsonaro, Lira, and Calheiros illustrate how surnames, ally networks, and electoral strongholds are inherited, reinforcing the reproduction of oligarchies across the ideological spectrum.

item.title: Defesa de Lulinha avalia pedir queda total de sigilos de inquéritos ao STF
item.description: The defense of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, is considering requesting the Supreme Court to lift total secrecy on investigations against him in Justice André Mendonça's office. The move would be a strategic step to bring transparency to the proceedings.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro celebra com suspeitos de rachadinha em atos da campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) appeared at campaign events alongside two suspects accused of operating the 'rachadinha' kickback scheme in his former state deputy office. Their presence raises further questions about his ties to corruption.

item.title: Lula dobra menções à 'soberania' e esquerda encampa tema da Defesa
item.description: Lula's 2026 government program doubles mentions of 'sovereignty' (42 vs 22 in 2022) and emphasizes 'health' (43 mentions) and 'democracy' (19). The left adopts defense as a key theme.

item.title: A direita latino-americana está dividida em relação a Lula
item.description: The Latin American right is not unified in opposition to Lula. While Javier Milei adopts an openly hostile stance, other 'blue wave' presidents seek cordial and constructive relations with the Brazilian government.

item.title: Por que Flávio Bolsonaro ataca Lula, mas não muito, no caso Lulinha/Marcola
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro has criticized Lula over the Lulinha/Marcola case, claiming that INSS corruption reached the president's office through Marcola. However, the Zero Um campaign has not pushed the investigations into Lula's son and former chief of staff to the forefront of its attacks, keeping the issue peripheral.

item.title: Marçal pode chegar ao primeiro turno sem saber se candidatura é válida
item.description: The Supreme Electoral Court is racing against time to rule on whether Pablo Marçal (PRTB) can run for president before the first round on October 4, despite his eight-year ineligibility. Rapporteur Minister Estela Aranha must receive registration requests by August 31, followed by a six‑day analysis period and possible defense stages that could stretch the decision close to election day.

item.title: Campanhas tentam evitar que Pablo Marçal vá aos debates
item.description: Campaigns pressure Band to exclude Pablo Marçal from the first 2026 presidential debate, arguing his party skipped rule-setting meetings and he is ineligible until 2032. The debate will likely feature only Renan Santos, Romeu Zema, and Ronaldo Caiado, with Lula absent and Flávio Bolsonaro attending only if Lula participates.

item.title: Charge do Aroeira
item.description: Aroeira cartoon and Noblat Blog articles cover investigations involving Lula's son, with Federal Police contradicting Minister Moraes in a Maranhão blogger case. Analyses discuss Lula's 2026 electoral prospects and current political scenario.

item.title: Tarcísio estuda nova forma de desgastar Haddad com taxa das blusinhas
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, running for re-election, is exploring strategies to undermine Fernando Haddad by linking him to the 'tax on blusinhas,' which was implemented during Haddad's tenure at the Finance Ministry. Lula advocates for the tax's repeal and blames Haddad for its creation, while Tarcísio criticizes the electoral timing of the measure.

item.title: A 45 dias do primeiro turno, Lula e Flávio evitam debates e sabatinas
item.description: With 45 days until the first round, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are avoiding debates and media interviews to minimize risks and attacks from opponents. While Lula's campaign questions candidate invitations and avoids being targeted alone, Flávio has stated he will only attend debates if Lula is present.

item.title: Confira agenda dos candidatos ao governo de SP nesta quinta (20/8)
item.description: The candidates for São Paulo governor continue their campaign agendas on the fifth official campaign day, with highlights for the main contenders Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Fernando Haddad (PT). Haddad has a Record interview and walk in Capão Redondo, while Carlos Machado (PCB) launches government plan. Polls show Tarcísio leading with 50% of voter intentions.

item.title: Como atuava a consultoria de amiga de Lulinha que intermediava negócios em Brasília
item.description: The Federal Police is investigating businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Lulinha, for mediating businesses in Brasília through RL Consultoria. Seized messages reveal contacts with companies holding federal contracts and attempts to close deals, including cannabis-based medications with a waiver of bidding at the Ministry of Health.

item.title: SP lidera mapa nacional de roubos de celular com 3 em cada 10 registros
item.description: São Paulo leads Brazil's ranking for cell phone thefts and robberies, accounting for 29% of devices registered in the National Restricted Cell Phone Database (BNCR). The database, with about 3 million records, was crucial for Operation Last Call, which recovered thousands of devices and notified suspects. The program integrates security forces to combat crime and the resale chain.

item.title: O cerco a Lula através do filho: oitivas enroladas e freio no Master
item.description: The Noblat panel discussed how the opposition could exploit investigations against Lulinha and Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola) to damage Lula's campaign. Lulinha's defense offered testimony multiple times, but the Federal Police and the Supreme Court rapporteur have not scheduled the hearing, extending the issue into the campaign. Attention was drawn to the silence surrounding the Banco Master scandal, involving Flávio Bolsonaro and calls with banker Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Como os números dos candidatos vão parar na urna? Entenda quem define e como funciona a escolha
item.description: Candidate numbers on electronic voting machines are defined by Brazil's Superior Electoral Court following specific rules for each position, with numbers typically drawn in party conventions. Candidates who already have a number associated with their name may keep it when running for the same office under the same party, which helps voters remember them.

item.title: Às vésperas da eleição, governo Lula avalia reduzir juros do Minha Casa, Minha Vida
item.description: The Lula government is considering lowering interest rates for Faixa 3 of the Minha Casa, Minha Vida program to benefit lower-income families. The measure is seen as an alternative to pressure from the construction sector to expand the program to the middle class.
